name: RadioField
summary: Choose one option from a surrounding radio group with supporting validation text.

useWhen: Capturing one choice from a mutually exclusive set of options.
Showing a description or an error beside an option of a RadioGroup.
avoidWhen: For options that are only a label; use the RadioGroup options list.
For independent settings or when several choices may be selected; use CheckboxGroup.

obligations: Root requires a stable string value while the surrounding RadioGroup owns selection changes and roving keyboard focus.

behavior: A RadioField must sit inside a RadioGroup and throws without one.
Root needs a stable string value, the same value the group reports in its onChange.
The group owns the selected value, the change callback, and arrow-key focus.
A RadioField has no onChange of its own.
disabled on a RadioField disables that option; on the group it disables every option.
readOnly belongs on the RadioGroup, where it stops every option from changing.
size follows the group unless the RadioField sets its own.
A RadioField is invalid when the group is invalid or when it sets invalid itself.
Description is linked to the option's input.
Error appears only while the option is invalid, and is linked to that option's input.
Error has role="alert" unless it is given another role.
Button is a label that wraps the radio input, and its ref is the label element.
accessibility: Root requires a stable string value while the surrounding RadioGroup owns selection changes and roving keyboard focus.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
